history_invariants: Exactly one linear Git commit is permitted per phase.
The remote successor branch is initialized at the frozen base before P0, and every phase PushEvent must name the exact preceding commit in before_sha.
Every change in a phase commit is an added file inside that phase's allowed surface.
Every file in a phase is introduced with its record in the same commit.
P1, P2 and P3 may contain only record.json and MANIFEST.json; transcript or attachment files are outside the allowlist.
P1, P2 and P3 claims arrays remain empty; later observations, findings and dispositions use closed typed fields without free-form narrative.
Every previous phase remains byte-identical to its introduction commit.
P0's GitHub PushEvent must predate the preregistered drand round.
P1's GitHub PushEvent must not predate the preregistered drand round.
P1, P2 and P3 each require the preceding phase's independently queryable GitHub PushEvent.
No field can designate one canonical truth.
